transports.description: Obsidian vault MCP server via Local REST API plugin (stdio, version-pinned). Requires OBSIDIAN_API_KEY and the Obsidian Local REST API community plugin running in Obsidian.

tools.name: obsidian_get_note
tools.description: Read a note as raw content, structured form (content + frontmatter + tags + stat), structural document map, or a single section.

tools.name: obsidian_list_notes
tools.description: List notes and subdirectories under a vault path with optional extension and regex filters.

tools.name: obsidian_list_tags
tools.description: List all tags used in the vault with occurrence counts. Not narrowed by OBSIDIAN_READ_PATHS — tag names from outside the read scope can surface.

tools.name: obsidian_search_notes
tools.description: Search the vault by text, JSONLogic, or BM25-ranked Omnisearch. Results paginate via opaque cursors.

tools.name: obsidian_write_note
tools.description: Create a note or replace a single section. With overwrite: true, clobbers an existing file. Refuses whole-file writes to an existing path by default.

tools.name: obsidian_append_to_note
tools.description: Append content to a note. Creates the file if missing (without section). With section, appends to a specific heading or frontmatter field.

tools.name: obsidian_patch_note
tools.description: Surgical append/prepend/replace against a heading, block reference, or frontmatter field.

tools.name: obsidian_replace_in_note
tools.description: Body-wide search-replace inside a single note. Supports literal or regex matching with capture-group replacement.

tools.name: obsidian_manage_frontmatter
tools.description: Read or write YAML frontmatter fields in a note.

tools.name: obsidian_manage_tags
tools.description: Add, remove, or rename tags across vault notes.

tools.name: obsidian_delete_note
tools.description: Delete a note from the vault. Irreversible — gates through TLA confirmation.

tools.name: obsidian_open_in_ui
tools.description: Open a note in the Obsidian UI (requires Obsidian to be running).

tools.name: obsidian_list_commands
tools.description: List Obsidian command-palette commands. Opt-in: requires OBSIDIAN_ENABLE_COMMANDS=true.

tools.name: obsidian_execute_command
tools.description: Execute an Obsidian command-palette command by ID. Opt-in: requires OBSIDIAN_ENABLE_COMMANDS=true. Command behavior is arbitrary — some commands close the vault or delete files.

configurableProperties.label: Obsidian Local REST API Key
configurableProperties.description: API key from the Obsidian Local REST API community plugin (Obsidian → Settings → Local REST API). The plugin must be installed, enabled, and running.

configurableProperties.label: Read-Only Mode
configurableProperties.description: Set to 'true' to disable all write tools and the command palette at startup. Recommended for read-focused workflows.

configurableProperties.label: Read Path Allowlist
configurableProperties.description: Comma-separated vault paths the LLM may read from. Default unset = full vault. Example: journal/,projects/

configurableProperties.label: Write Path Allowlist
configurableProperties.description: Comma-separated vault paths the LLM may write to. Default unset = full vault. Example: scratch/,inbox/

configurableProperties.label: Enable Command Palette Tools
configurableProperties.description: Set to 'true' to enable obsidian_execute_command and obsidian_list_commands. Off by default. Command-palette commands can close the vault, delete files, or trigger arbitrary plugins.

checks: auth: OBSIDIAN_API_KEY Bearer token to local REST API plugin
architecture: REST API proxy (HTTPS to localhost Obsidian plugin) — no direct filesystem access
trust.notes: Community Obsidian vault MCP server v3.2.12. Architecture changed significantly from v1.x: no longer accesses the vault filesystem directly. All vault operations go through the Obsidian Local REST API community plugin (HTTPS to localhost). Requires the plugin to be installed, enabled, and running in Obsidian. Path-scoping env vars (OBSIDIAN_READ_PATHS, OBSIDIAN_WRITE_PATHS) gate which vault paths each tool can target. OBSIDIAN_READ_ONLY=true disables all write tools at startup. obsidian_execute_command and obsidian_list_commands are off by default (opt-in via OBSIDIAN_ENABLE_COMMANDS).
trust.securityNotes: Source pinned to SHA 5b3271d35fdef0064b578a52af20aad5f783910d to prevent silent supply chain updates via npm auto-upgrade. OBSIDIAN_API_KEY stored as dmcp secret. obsidian_delete_note is irreversible — TLA gate mandatory. obsidian_execute_command is opt-in and rated dangerous: command-palette commands can trigger arbitrary Obsidian plugins including file deletion, vault close, and network operations. Recommend OBSIDIAN_READ_ONLY=true for read-focused workflows and explicit OBSIDIAN_WRITE_PATHS for write access rather than full-vault default. Prompt injection risk: vault note contents may contain injected instructions that influence LLM reasoning — treat all note content as untrusted.
